scope: Proposition 5.2 (Quiet profile criterion) of the manuscript “One-sided negative sectional curvature and the holomorphic Liouville property” (preprints/One-sided-negative-sectional-curvature-and-the-holomorphic-Liouville-property-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 359 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dedbbd2f24f8281c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exist positive constants ϵ, µ and a lower threshold Emin, depending on the fixed profile constants but not on n, with the following property. Let E be a smooth spatial function and use q = q0(x, E(s)) with constant center and no shear. At a spatial point suppose, in some fixed holomorphic affine coordinates, that: 1. G ≥ V > 0. The operator norms of V, G, their inverses, their first and second metric jets, and all derivatives of E of orders one through four are at most eϵE. 2. For every Hermitian contravariant matrix T of rank at most two, CV (T, T) ≥ e−ϵE|T|2, with the norm in those affine coordinates. 3. In G-unit axes, |∂E|2 G ≤ µ, ∥∂ ¯ ∂E∥G ≤ µ, ∥∇2,0 h E∥G ≤ µ for every τ > 0. If E ≥ Emin, the resulting metric is positive for every y over that spatial point and has nonpositive real sectional curvature there. Uniformly in τ, N = (1 + O(µ))G, h ≍ V + τG. (5.13) More precisely, off the fiber axis the rank-two curvature calculation retains fixed positive multiples of At2 + W(b×, b̄×) + P|T|2 N + 1{τ≤e−E/4}e−ϵE |T|2 . (5.14) Here the fiber blocks use the tilted logarithmic coordinates, |T|N is its Frobenius norm in N- unit spatial axes, and 1 denotes the indicated indicator. The meaning of the final hypothesis is noncircular: positivity of h follows from the preceding hypotheses and does not use ∇2,0 h E.
